description: Convert a booking code from one source bookmaker to 1 target bookmaker or a synchronous batch of up to 6 target bookmakers. Costs 2 credits per target that produces a code; failed targets are automatically refunded. To convert to all bookmakers at once (up to 29), use mbc_convert_to_all.

to_bookmakers.description: Target bookmaker key/alias or list of 1 to 6 targets (e.g. '1xng' or ['1xng', 'bet9ja', 'msport']).

name: mbc_convert_code
title: Convert Bet Code (1 to 6 Targets)
